segments.title: 3 real AI fails, on record
segments.say: Three real AI fails, all on the public record.

segments.title: Not tested by us
segments.say: Not tested by us: based on official info and news.

segments.title: 1. Glue on pizza
segments.say: One: Google's AI search answers suggested glue on pizza.

segments.title: Source: Google's own blog
segments.say: Google's own blog said it came from forum content.

segments.title: 2. A refund rule that wasn't
segments.say: Two: Air Canada's chatbot told a customer he could get a bereavement refund. The real policy said no.

segments.title: Source: CBS News
bullets: A tribunal made the airline pay
segments.say: A tribunal ordered the airline to pay.

segments.title: 3. Six fake court cases
segments.say: Three: lawyers filed six fake cases ChatGPT made up.

segments.title: Source: Reuters
segments.say: A judge fined them, Reuters reported.

segments.title: The fix
segments.say: The fix: check AI answers against the original source.
